title: Scribbled Heads
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Depth pass, October 16, 2026. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 640 px as one wall and at 1200 px for the labelled works. Dates and stroke counts come from data/gallery.json; the artist's posts of February 18, July 15 to 28, August 1 to 2 and August 11, 2022 from curation/research/social/x-posts.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 28 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Heads buried in line. In this room the face is drawn, and then drawn over, until it sits inside a tangle of colored scribble like a thing seen through weeds. Most of the grounds are black, slate or brown, and nearly every mouth shows its teeth. Twenty-eight works, from June 16 to August 19, 2022, and they are the darkest of the mask summer: the square and round masks next door are toys, and these are not.

Two things happen under the scribble. Some of the heads are painted first, with shadow on the cheek and light on the brow, and the line is laid over paint. Others are nothing but line, and the head is the place where the scribble gets densest. The difference is easy to see once you look for it: paint has edges that are soft, and line has none. In February the artist wrote that it is not the task of a work to fully reveal itself to the recipient, and called art a dope that makes every exploration unique. These heads are that sentence drawn: a face is there, and the line is what keeps it from being handed over.

The room's busiest stretch is one week, July 26 to 31, with fourteen heads in six days, in the middle of the month the artist was handing out cats to every holder and writing about an open-ended collection named after Warhol's Index Book. Watch the teeth across that week. They end up as the one clear thing in a face that has otherwise come apart, and then, on the last day of the summer, the scribble turns to soft gold rings and the face is only spirals.

chapters.title: Painted Heads Under Line
chapters.opening: June 16 to July 8. A profile on red, then a run of heads painted in gold and brown with the scribble drawn on top. The painted ones are the ones with feeling in them.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #147
works.text: A black skull in profile inside a black square on red, drawn in a few yellow and white lines, with a spiral eye, a row of yellow teeth and a stitched line running down the back of the head.
works.caption: A black skull in profile inside a black square on red, a spiral eye, yellow teeth, a stitched line behind.
works.reading: The skull is the one flat shape in the room: solid black, with the features drawn on it in thin yellow. The ear is a yellow loop, the teeth a short zigzag. White stripes hang at the left edge like curtains, and a small black house shape sits at the lower right with a blue tree inside it. Thirty-six strokes, the fewest in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #153
works.text: A horned head painted in gold, brown and blue, with heavy lids and a bearded jaw, drawn over in pink, white and blue line. The paint underneath is modelled: the brow catches light, the cheeks fall into shadow, the beard is a block of dark strokes. The line on top loops around the horns and down the face without covering it. It is the first painted head in the room, made June 24, and the one where the paint and the line are most clearly two layers. The lids are heavy and the horns are small. This is a tired devil, and the scribble over it is not a disguise so much as weather.
works.caption: A horned head painted in gold and brown with a bearded jaw, drawn over in pink, white and blue line.
works.reading: The two horns are short and curved, drawn in blue and gold strokes at the top corners of the head. The eyes are narrow slits under thick lids. Bands of yellow, blue and red stand at the left and right edges like a stage curtain.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #160
works.text: A furry monster in the dark with two narrow eyes and a wide open mouth of white teeth, its fur a mass of green, red, blue and white scribble edged in white.
works.caption: A furry monster in the dark, two narrow eyes, a wide open mouth of white teeth, fur in colored scribble.
works.reading: The mouth is a dark cave with a row of white teeth top and bottom, and it takes up the whole lower face. The eyes are two slits with green and yellow around them. The fur is drawn in long outward strokes with a thick white edge that holds the creature together against the black.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #161
works.text: A brown head with a crown of spikes painted in gold, blue and purple, two round ringed eyes and a small zigzag mouth, framed by grey loops.
works.caption: A brown head crowned with spikes, painted in gold, blue and purple, two round ringed eyes.
works.reading: The head is a tall rounded shape with the crown rising from both sides like horns. The eyes are drawn as two rings with spirals inside, one white and one gold. The grey loops at the edges are a loose border drawn in single strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #163
works.text: An elephant's head, or a skull with a trunk, painted in gold and purple with a red target for one eye and a pink spiral for the other, a mouth of white teeth at the bottom of the trunk. Yellow, blue and white scribble runs over the whole head, and purple drips fall from the jaw. The two eyes are the room's two kinds at once: a target on the left and a spiral on the right. It was drawn on July 4, 2022. One eye is aimed at and the other is dizzy, and the trunk ends in teeth. Of all the heads in the room it is the one most plainly in distress, and the drips from the jaw are the picture admitting it.
works.caption: An elephant's head painted in gold and purple, a red target for one eye, a pink spiral for the other.
works.reading: The trunk hangs down the center in grey and black strokes, and the teeth sit at its base like a cuff. The ears are two broad shapes at the sides, painted in tan with scribble over them. The ground is purple at the edges and brown behind the head.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #166
works.caption: A grey bald head with a heavy brow, one eye in shadow, a black mustache and white fangs.
works.reading: The eye at the right is a white slit under a red lid, and the left eye is lost in the dark of the brow. The fangs are a row of white triangles with black between. Green, red and purple scribble fills the cheeks, and the ground is a flat grey.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #167
works.text: A dark round head in a frame, lit by two gold beams from the upper left, its open mouth a ring of white teeth, painted in brown and gold with scribble over it.
works.caption: A dark round head in a frame lit by two gold beams, its open mouth a ring of white teeth.
works.reading: The beams are two broad wedges of gold with soft edges, and they cross the head from the upper left to the mouth. The mouth is a dark hole with white teeth around it. The frame is a thin dark band inside a cream border.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #172
works.text: A green head with a grinning mouth of white teeth, two narrow eyes under a dark brow, and a crest of spikes, painted and scribbled on dark green.
works.caption: A green head with a grin of white teeth and a crest of spikes, painted and scribbled on dark green.
works.reading: The grin is a wide white mouth with a dark line down the middle and red at the corners. The eyes are two narrow boxes with small pupils. The crest is a set of green and yellow spikes rising from the top of the head.

chapters.title: Mid July
chapters.opening: Four heads from July 19 to 26. A red X returns to an eye, a brown head wears a bucket, and the line starts to take over. The cats were going out to every holder that week.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #184
works.text: A dark head with a red X in one eye, a yellow bar across the brow like a headband, and a grille of white teeth, drawn in dense colored scribble.
works.caption: A dark scribbled head with a red X in one eye, a yellow headband, a grille of white teeth.
works.reading: The X is drawn in thick red over a pink ring, and the other eye is a white ring with a red center. The yellow bar runs through both eyes and out past the head. Two green ovals sit above the eyes like a second pair.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #189
works.text: A brown head on pale blue, painted in purple and tan with a flat top like a bucket, half-closed eyes and a grin of small teeth. Yellow and white dashes ring the head like a string of lights, and purple line loops around it. It is the one head in the room that smiles with its eyes closed, and the only one on a light ground. It was drawn on July 23, in the week the artist was sending a free cat to every holder of an ink and posting their names with thanks. A contented face, drawn once, in the middle of the summer's generosity, and then not again.
works.caption: A brown head on pale blue, flat-topped like a bucket, half-closed eyes and a grin of small teeth.
works.reading: The eyes are two narrow slits with heavy purple lids. The grin is a row of small white and yellow teeth in a dark mouth. The dashes around the head are drawn in white and yellow at even spacing. A blue zigzag at the lower left is the only cool mark.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #190
works.text: A head on purple, painted in brown and red, with one dark eye and one eye of white rings around a red center, a mouth of white teeth, drawn over in blue and white line.
works.caption: A head on purple, one eye dark, the other white rings around a red center, white teeth.
works.reading: The ringed eye at the right spreads out across the forehead, with a yellow line running through it like a beam. The dark eye at the left is a red knot. The teeth are a row of white blocks in a dark mouth.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #193
works.text: A tangle of dark grey, white and pink line with a small red devil at the right, its spiral eye and grin of white teeth the only clear thing in the picture.
works.caption: A tangle of dark grey, white and pink line, a small red devil at the right with a spiral eye.
works.reading: The devil's head is a red knot of line with a yellow bar through it, and its teeth are a white grille at the lower right. The rest of the square is vertical scribble in grey, white and pink with a few yellow bars across it. The face is hard to find.

chapters.title: Six Days in July
chapters.opening: July 26 to 31, fourteen heads. The scribble is densest here, and the teeth are the one clear thing in most of them. In the same days the artist was naming the Index collection, a series that would only grow when every copy of the last piece had sold.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #194
works.caption: A skull in red, black and grey scribble, a ringed eye and a boxed eye, a jaw of white teeth.
works.reading: The teeth run across the lower third as a row of white bars with red between them. The left eye is a ring drawn many times in black and blue. A pink bar sits at the right like a bandage.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #195
works.text: A face in black scribble on orange, with a red X over one eye and a white ring for the other, a yellow bar across the brow, and two rows of white teeth in a dark mouth. The black line is drawn thickest here of any work in the room, in heavy vertical strokes down the cheeks. The X is as big as the eye socket and drawn in red over the black. It is the angriest head in the room, and it was made on July 26, the first of fourteen in six days. The cancelled eye, the bared teeth and the black pouring down the face say one thing together, and the orange behind them says it loudly.
works.caption: A face in heavy black scribble on orange, a red X over one eye, two rows of white teeth.
works.reading: The X at the upper left is drawn in red over a black ring, and the white eye at the right is a ring with a small dark pupil. The yellow bar runs through both. The teeth are white rounded blocks in two rows with black between.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #196
works.text: A head seen from the side on dark purple, its eye a blue spiral the size of a fist, its mouth a row of white teeth, drawn in orange, blue and black line.
works.caption: A head in profile on dark purple, its eye a blue spiral the size of a fist, white teeth.
works.reading: The spiral is drawn in blue with a dark center and sits low on the face. The line around the head is orange and black in long strokes. The teeth are white bars at the lower right.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #197
works.caption: A teal ground scribbled over in black, yellow and pink, a mask of ringed eyes and white teeth inside it.
works.reading: The mask is drawn in a box at the center with two ringed eyes and a grille of white teeth at the bottom. Yellow bars run across it at angles. The scribble is loosest at the edges and tightest around the eyes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #199
works.text: A slate ground, a boxy head drawn in green, orange and white line, a red X over one eye, and a wide grin of white teeth in a red jaw.
works.caption: A boxy head on slate in green and orange line, a red X over one eye, a wide white grin.
works.reading: The X is drawn in red bars over a yellow box at the upper right. The grin is a long row of white blocks in a red mouth with black between them. Green bars stand at the edges like a frame.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #200
works.caption: A round head on dark blue crowned with yellow spikes, a ringed eye and a boxed eye.
works.reading: The crown is a row of yellow spikes with a red edge at the top of the head. The mouth is a red box with white teeth drawn large. Yellow bars run across the right side.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #201
works.text: A painted head on grey, in brown, black and gold, with two eyes that look out, a flat nose and a closed mouth, drawn over in yellow and purple line. Nothing is bared here. It is the one head in the room with its mouth shut and its eyes open, and the one most like a person. With 296 recorded strokes it is also the most worked. The eyes are level and a little sad. In a week of fourteen heads that grin and snarl through scribble, the artist stopped on July 28 to paint one that simply looks back, and then covered it with line as if to take it back. It is the nearest thing in the wing to a self-portrait, and nothing in the record says it is one.
works.caption: A painted head on grey in brown, black and gold, two eyes looking out, a closed mouth.
works.reading: The eyes are two dark rings with white in them, under a heavy brow drawn in black. The nose is a flat triangle of black. The mouth is a short line with pink around it. Purple scribble hangs at the lower right like a scarf.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #202
works.text: A bear-like head on brown with two ringed eyes, a red mouth of white teeth at the bottom, and a second row of teeth above it, drawn in dense colored scribble.
works.caption: A bear-like head on brown with two ringed eyes and two rows of white teeth in a red mouth.
works.reading: The ears are two rounded shapes at the top corners. The upper teeth are a row of small white blocks under the eyes, and the lower jaw is a wide red mouth with white bars. A black bar runs across the top like a brow.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #203
works.text: A brown figure with a mop of hair, square glasses, a grin of white teeth, and a coat drawn in gold and brown strokes, sitting on a brown ground, the one in the week that is pleased with itself.
works.caption: A brown figure with a mop of hair, square glasses, a grin of white teeth, and a gold coat.
works.reading: The glasses are two boxes joined by a bridge, with spirals in the lenses. The grin is a wide row of white teeth. The coat is painted in gold and brown with white edges, and the hands rest at the bottom.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #206
works.text: A slate ground, a mask with a spiral eye in a yellow box and a red arrow driving through its mouth of white teeth, drawn in pink, blue and yellow line.
works.caption: A mask on slate with a spiral eye in a yellow box and a red arrow through its white teeth.
works.reading: The arrow is drawn as a red bar with a yellow point at the lower right, running from the left eye through the mouth. The spiral eye is drawn in green and yellow. The other eye is a white box with a pink ring.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #207
works.caption: A skull on teal in white and black line, two spiral eyes and a jaw of white teeth.
works.reading: The skull is drawn as a tall oval with a thick white edge. The spiral eyes are two black knots with a dark triangle between them for a nose. The jaw is a wide row of white bars.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #208
works.caption: A dark skull in dense scribble, a yellow bar across one eye, a mouth of white bars at the bottom.
works.reading: The skull is drawn in red, blue and white loops over a grey ground, and the yellow bar runs from the upper left through the left eye. The right eye is a red box. The teeth are a row of white bars with black between.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #209
works.caption: A dark head, a spiral for the left eye, a red X for the right, a yellow bar through both.
works.reading: The spiral at the left is drawn in blue and white, and the X at the right is red over a pink box. The yellow bar runs through both eyes and out to the right. The jaw is white bars in a red mouth.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #210
works.text: A dark head with a spiral eye at the right and a red X at the left, white teeth in a red mouth, and the yellow bar again, in dense red, blue and white scribble, four days after the heavy black face on orange.
works.caption: A dark head, red X for the left eye, spiral for the right, white teeth in a red mouth.
works.reading: The X here is drawn in red bars over a blue ring at the upper left, and the spiral is drawn at the upper right in blue and white. The teeth are a row of white bars with red between them. The ground is dark grey.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #211
works.text: A black skull in profile on red and orange, facing right, with a yellow crown of spikes along the back of the head, a spiral eye, a mouth of white teeth and a yellow bar through the face.
works.caption: A black skull in profile on red and orange, a yellow crown along its back, a spiral eye, white teeth.
works.reading: The skull is painted in black and red with blue at the top. The spiral eye is a ring of white and blue. The yellow bar runs from the eye to the right edge. The crown is a row of yellow spikes with black between.

chapters.title: The Last Face
chapters.opening: One work from August 19, made the same day as the last masks and a week into the burning: a face of spirals in soft gold.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #231
works.text: A face made of spirals: a square spiral for one eye, a round spiral for the other, a third spiral at the right edge like an ear, and a mouth of white zigzag. Everything is drawn in thin black and gold line over soft gold circles, and the whole square is a ring of rings. Where the first head in the room was a black skull in a box on red, this one has no edge at all. It is the last work of the mask summer, drawn August 19, 2022, with 57 strokes, a week after the artist began burning the unsold inks. Nothing in it is angry. The spirals go round and the gold is warm, and after ten weeks of teeth the summer ends on a face that is only dizzy, and at peace about it.
works.caption: A face made of spirals in thin black and gold line over soft gold circles, a mouth of white zigzag.
works.reading: The circles underneath are drawn in soft gold at several sizes, overlapping, so the ground glows. The spirals are drawn in thin black and orange line, one square and two round. The mouth is three rows of white zigzag in a gold box. Vertical bars of darker gold run through the circles like columns.

closing: The first skull is flat black in its box on red. The last face is spirals in gold. The one is all edge and the other is all circle. In between, the scribble closed over the faces and the teeth were what was left showing. A head that will not reveal itself is still a head that wants to be looked at, and the artist spent the summer drawing twenty-eight of them.

collectorDecisions.decision: Collector, 2026-10-16: depth pass. Market, platform, people and the collector may be named; the artist's sourced words may be read for feeling.
